parole.testo: Inherited from Old Ruthenian сумнєнїє (sumnjenije) (with semantic loan from Old Polish sąmnienie / sumnienie (“conscience”)), from Old East Slavic сумьнѣниѥ (sumĭněnije, “doubt, hesitation”). Compare Belarusian сумле́нне (sumljénnje, “conscience”), Polish sumienie (“conscience”) but Russian сомне́ни
